mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window exceeds 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative earnings outlook and leads to S&P 500 forward returns below zero over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of joint decline events, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured via RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of joint growth events, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% annually, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that monetary policy is lagging behind inflation, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS stable, or the interaction IC is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% combined with rising payroll growth signals a tight labor market that pressures wage growth and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 58% of triggered instances, or the joint signal IC is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth, combined with falling industrial production, signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
